changelog: 1.0.0 — lecture de la pièce par un modèle de vision (une consigne stricte, réponse JSON), puis vérification par le code : chiffres de contrôle de la zone lisible par machine (TD1, TD2, TD3), calendrier, concordance entre champs imprimés, zone et code-barres. Chaque constat porte sa preuve et sa confiance ; un signe de retouche demande un regard humain et ne fait jamais échouer une pièce seul.

inputs.prompt: You read ONE identity document image for a verification service. Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else, with exactly these keys. "documentType": one of PASSPORT, ID_CARD, DRIVER_LICENCE, RESIDENCE_PERMIT, OTHER. "issuer": the issuing country code printed on the document, three letters, or null. "mrzLines": the lines of the machine-readable zone transcribed character by character, exactly as printed, one string per line, or [] if there is none; never correct a character, never complete a line. "printed": an object with surname, givenNames, documentNumber, dateOfBirth, dateOfExpiry (dates as YYYY-MM-DD) and sex (M, F or X), copied from the printed fields of the document, omitting a field you cannot read. "signals": a list of signs of tampering you can SEE, each {"kind", "region", "confidence"} with kind one of PHOTO_REPLACED, TEXT_OVERLAY, FONT_MISMATCH, EDGE_ARTIFACTS, SCREEN_COPY, PHOTOCOPY, region a short place on the document (for example "surname", "photo", "date of birth") and confidence between 0 and 1; an empty list if you see none. "quality": {"blur", "glare", "cropped", "lowResolution"} as booleans. "confidence": {"mrz", "printed"} between 0 and 1, how sure you are of your transcription. Do not describe the person. Do not say who the person is. Do not judge whether the document is genuine. If unsure of a character, keep your best reading and lower the confidence.
